questions.question: Why didn't Rocket Girl simply break down the cell door?
options: She couldn't break iron doors.
She was afraid of the dark.
She wanted to surprise Mr. Sweeps without warning him.
She had lost all her superpowers.
questions.explanation: 罗克西知道自己能破坏牢门，但担心斯威普斯听见，所以想找一种办法悄悄接近他。

questions.question: How did Rocket Girl escape while everyone guarded the cell door?
options: She blasted through the cavern floor behind them.
She hid inside a mine cart.
She borrowed the detective's key.
She jumped out through the ceiling.
questions.explanation: 大家都守在牢门前时，火箭女孩从洞穴地面后方冲出，成功绕过了守门的学生。

questions.question: What did Rocket Girl destroy with her eye lasers?
options: The diamonds in the mine.
The locked basement doors.
The teachers' cars.
Mr. Sweeps's glowing ring.
questions.explanation: 罗克西用眼睛发出的激光击中斯威普斯手上的戒指，戒指爆炸，打破了他的控制。

questions.question: What did Rocket Girl tell the students after they were freed?
options: They had been practicing for a school play.
Mr. Sweeps had hypnotized them to make them mine diamonds.
Principal Penn had asked them to study underground.
The detective had organized a treasure hunt.
questions.explanation: 学生们醒来后，火箭女孩解释斯威普斯是假校长，利用催眠逼迫他们在学校地下挖钻石。

questions.question: How could the school pay for its zoo field trip after the rescue?
options: Mayor Bloom canceled the ticket prices.
The teachers found money at the hotel.
Principal Penn planned to sell the diamonds.
Mr. Sweeps offered to buy a new bus.
questions.explanation: 玛拉说潘校长准备出售地下矿洞中的钻石，因此学校重新有钱组织去动物园的校外活动。

questions.question: Who appeared suddenly at the television studio?
options: A magician with a tall hat and a monkey on his shoulder.
Rocket Girl with a new robot.
Detective Smith carrying a camera.
A teacher from Metro City Elementary.
questions.explanation: 电视台准备拍摄时，一名戴高帽、留细胡子、穿燕尾服且肩上坐着猴子的神秘魔术师突然出现。

questions.question: Why did Terrell think Mighty Man was less impressive than Rocket Girl?
options: He had never seen the television show.
Mighty Man was only a fictional television character.
Mighty Man had stolen the school's money.
Terrell disliked every superhero.
questions.explanation: 特雷尔指出Mighty Man只是电视中的虚构角色，而火箭女孩是真实帮助城市的超级英雄。

questions.question: Which superhero did Roxy say was cooler?
options: The hero on the television show.
Neither superhero.
A superhero from another city.
Rocket Girl.
questions.explanation: 当朋友们询问罗克西的意见时，她同意特雷尔，觉得火箭女孩比电视中的Mighty Man更厉害。

questions.question: What did the strange man announce on television?
options: He would host a cooking show.
He was closing the TV station for repairs.
Mighty Man was canceled and his own magic show would replace it.
The city's zoo trip would be on television.
questions.explanation: 那名神秘男子在电视上宣称Mighty Man节目已取消，取而代之的是由他主演的魔术秀。

questions.question: What emergency did Mayor Bloom tell Roxy about?
options: Mr. Presto had taken over the television station.
The zoo animals had escaped.
Detective Smith had gone missing.
Someone had stolen a school bus.
questions.explanation: 市长通过手表告诉罗克西，邪恶魔术师普雷斯托控制了电视台，需要火箭女孩出面阻止。

questions.question: What excuse did Roxy give her friends before leaving?
options: She wanted to watch the show alone.
She was going to visit the hospital.
She had promised to help her mother with chores.
She needed to buy more snacks.
questions.explanation: 为了隐瞒自己去处理事件的真实原因，罗克西对朋友们说想起要回家帮妈妈做家务。

questions.question: How did Rocket Girl open the locked room at the television station?
options: She used her eye lasers to blast the door.
The actor gave her a key.
She climbed in through a window.
Detective Smith opened it with his phone.
questions.explanation: 罗克西听到有人求救后，发现房门被锁住，于是发射眼部激光把门炸开。

questions.question: What did the television crew say Mr. Presto had stolen?
options: A bag of money.
A superhero costume.
All the television screens.
A camera.
questions.explanation: 被救出的电视台工作人员说普雷斯托偷走了一台摄像机，随后他们借助监视画面查看他的行动。

questions.question: What happened to Molly's diamond necklace?
options: It fell into the street.
Mr. Presto made it disappear during a magic trick.
Detective Smith took it for safekeeping.
Molly gave it to Rocket Girl.
questions.explanation: 普雷斯托向莫莉表演魔术，挥动魔杖并念出咒语后，她的钻石项链突然不见了。

questions.question: What did Mr. Presto make disappear from the man's wrist?
options: A bracelet.
A ring.
A watch.
A set of keys.
questions.explanation: 普雷斯托随后挑中一名戴着漂亮手表的男子，重复施法后，男子的手表也消失了。

questions.question: What surprised Mara while watching Mr. Presto on television?
options: The school was shown on the news.
Rocket Girl appeared on the television screen.
Mighty Man started singing.
The mayor began doing magic tricks.
questions.explanation: 玛拉在观看普雷斯托的节目时突然喊出火箭女孩上电视了，说明罗克西已经赶到现场。

questions.question: What was Mr. Presto planning as his greatest trick?
options: Make the moon vanish from the sky.
Turn every car into a toy.
Make all the money in Metro City Bank disappear.
Bring the Mighty Man actor back to the studio.
questions.explanation: 普雷斯托扬言要在观众面前施展最惊人的魔术，把大都会银行里的全部钱变没。

questions.question: How did Mr. Presto stop Rocket Girl's first charge?
options: He made a wall appear in front of her.
He froze the street beneath her.
He used a purple slime gun.
He ordered the police to block the road.
questions.explanation: 罗克西冲向普雷斯托时，他挥动魔杖制造一堵墙，罗克西来不及躲避，直接撞了上去。

questions.question: Why couldn't Rocket Girl grab Mr. Presto after jumping over the wall?
options: He drove away in a truck.
He ran into the bank vault.
The television cameras stopped working.
He made himself disappear.
questions.explanation: 罗克西翻过墙要抓住魔术师时，普雷斯托念出咒语，让自己突然消失，成功躲开她。

questions.question: What appeared in front of Rocket Girl when she flew at the magician?
options: A tower of books.
A big black box.
A frozen statue.
A school bus.
questions.explanation: 罗克西高速飞向普雷斯托时，他变出一个大黑箱，罗克西无法及时停下，撞进了箱子里。

questions.question: How did Mr. Presto learn that Rocket Girl had escaped the sword trick?
options: A detective called him.
The television went dark.
He opened the box and found a burned hole in its back.
He saw Rocket Girl hiding in his hat.
questions.explanation: 普雷斯托把剑插入黑箱后打开一看，箱内空空如也，背后还有被烧穿的洞，说明火箭女孩已逃脱。

questions.question: What happened to the people inside Metro City Bank when Mr. Presto used magic?
options: They disappeared and reappeared outside the bank.
They turned into statues.
They all fell asleep on the floor.
They were trapped in the elevator.
questions.explanation: 普雷斯托施展魔法使银行里的人突然消失，片刻后他们出现在银行外面。

questions.question: What did Mr. Presto do to reach the money in the bank?
options: He dug a tunnel under the vault.
He used a stolen card.
He asked the teller to unlock the safe.
He waved his wand and opened the metal door.
questions.explanation: 普雷斯托站到金属金库门前挥动魔杖念咒，沉重的门随即打开，他以为钱马上就是自己的。

questions.question: How did Rocket Girl end Mr. Presto's magic tricks?
options: She hid his hat in a locker.
She snapped his wand in half.
She turned off the bank cameras.
She took the magician's microphone.
questions.explanation: 火箭女孩从普雷斯托手中夺过魔杖，双手把它折断，阻止他继续使用魔法。

questions.question: What did Terrell do when Roxy returned to her friends?
options: He asked to watch Mighty Man again.
He gave her a snack.
He looked from the TV to Roxy suspiciously.
He rushed out to meet the magician.
questions.explanation: 罗克西回来后，特雷尔先看电视画面，再看她本人，神情怀疑，暗示他觉得她与火箭女孩的行踪有联系。

questions.question: What happened after thick fog filled the art gallery?
options: The paintings disappeared.
The lights became brighter.
The visitors saw a new sculpture.
The gallery closed for lunch.
questions.explanation: 画廊突然被浓雾笼罩，等雾散去，一名女士惊呼新画作都不见了。

questions.question: Why did Roxy say she liked fall best?
options: She could go swimming every day.
The zoo gave free tickets.
She loved the cool air and playing in leaves.
The school had no homework.
questions.explanation: 罗克西明确说秋天是她最爱的季节，因为天气凉爽，而且她喜欢在落叶堆里玩耍。

questions.question: What did Terrell suggest asking Rocket Girl to do?
options: Take everyone to the zoo.
Help them rake the backyard.
Find a lost dog in the park.
Make it snow for them.
questions.explanation: 几个朋友在秋天的后院玩落叶时，特雷尔提议请火箭女孩让天气下雪，好让大家玩雪。

questions.question: Why did Roxy reject Terrell's idea?
options: She said Rocket Girl was out of town.
She said Rocket Girl could not control the weather.
She thought snow would hurt the trees.
She wanted to finish her lunch first.
questions.explanation: 罗克西认为这个主意荒谬，因为火箭女孩并没有控制天气的超能力，无法随意让天空下雪。

questions.question: What crime did Mayor Bloom ask Rocket Girl to investigate?
options: All the new paintings at Metro City Art Gallery had been stolen.
Someone had stolen the school bus.
The Grand Hotel had been robbed.
A bank's money had vanished.
questions.explanation: 市长的电话说明，大都会美术馆刚展出的新画作全部被盗，火箭女孩必须展开调查。

questions.question: What clue did Detective Smith find at the art gallery?
options: A map marked with a school bus.
A small ball marked with a lightning bolt and the word 'fog'.
A bag of stolen diamonds.
An empty ice cream container.
questions.explanation: 探长在美术馆地上找到一个小球，一面有闪电标志，另一面写着fog，这是调查的重要线索。

questions.question: Why was the fog useful to the painting thief?
options: It made the paintings easier to carry.
It made the gallery warmer.
It turned the paintings invisible.
It prevented witnesses from seeing who stole them.
questions.explanation: 罗克西根据目击者的描述推断，浓雾遮挡视线，使在场的人无法看到是谁偷走画作。

questions.question: What vehicle were the police chasing on West Street?
options: A black van with lightning bolts on its sides.
A red school bus.
A white ambulance.
A pizza delivery truck.
questions.explanation: 警方在西街追逐的是一辆黑色货车，车身两侧画有闪电标志，与天气人的作案方式相符。

questions.question: How did Rocket Girl find the van after fog covered the street?
options: She followed its horn.
She asked people for directions.
She blew the fog away with a powerful breath.
She waited for the wind to change.
questions.explanation: 天气人用浓雾甩开警车后，罗克西深吸一口气用力吹散浓雾，才重新看清前方的货车。

questions.question: What danger did Weatherman create after throwing another Weather Ball?
options: A huge wave from the river.
A giant lightning bolt heading toward Rocket Girl.
A snowstorm inside the art gallery.
A wall that trapped the police.
questions.explanation: 天气人抛出天气球后天空变黑，云层聚集，一道巨大的闪电朝火箭女孩劈来。

questions.question: How did Rocket Girl avoid the first lightning bolt?
options: She hid inside a taxi.
She caught the lightning with her hands.
She flew behind a bank.
She dived aside just before it hit a mailbox.
questions.explanation: 火箭女孩在闪电击中邮箱前迅速扑向一旁，险险避开第一道闪电。

questions.question: What did Weatherman's next Weather Ball create on West Street?
options: A huge tornado.
A thick fog inside the bank.
A wall of solid ice.
A rain of diamonds.
questions.explanation: 天气人再次启动天气球后，狂风和轰鸣加剧，西街出现了一道巨大的龙卷风。

questions.question: Which vehicles did the tornado lift into the air with Rocket Girl?
options: A train and a truck.
Two school buses.
A bus and a taxi.
A police car and a bicycle.
questions.explanation: 龙卷风除了卷起罗克西，还卷走了一辆公交车和一辆出租车，车上的乘客十分惊恐。

questions.question: What did Rocket Girl grab after taking hold of the taxi?
options: A traffic light.
The bus.
The villain's van.
A fallen tree.
questions.explanation: 罗克西先用一只手抓住出租车，随后飞向被卷起的公交车并抓牢它，准备一起救走。

questions.question: How did Weatherman's van escape through the snow?
options: It began flying like a helicopter.
It drove into an underground tunnel.
Rocket Girl pushed it out of the snow.
Its wheels folded away and snow treads took their place.
questions.explanation: 天气人按下货车按钮后，原有车轮收起，换成能在雪地行驶的履带，随后开车逃走。

questions.question: Where did Rocket Girl set down the bus and taxi?
options: On the roof of the bank.
In front of the school.
On a safe, quiet street.
Inside the police station.
questions.explanation: 罗克西带着被龙卷风卷起的公交车与出租车，找到一条安全安静的街道，把两辆车放下来。

questions.question: Where did the police say Weatherman had gone?
options: Toward the mountains.
Toward the school cafeteria.
To the art gallery.
Back to Metro City Bank.
questions.explanation: 警方告诉火箭女孩天气人朝山里逃去，于是她沿着雪地中的货车痕迹追赶。

questions.question: How did Rocket Girl stop Weatherman's van in the blizzard?
options: She froze its tires with ice.
She blew a huge snowdrift in front of it.
She cut off the road with a laser wall.
She lifted it high into the clouds.
questions.explanation: 罗克西追上货车后用力吹出强风，在车前堆起巨大的雪堆，货车随后一头撞了上去。

questions.question: What did Rocket Girl do before Weatherman could throw another Weather Ball?
options: She took away his van keys.
She asked the police to stop him.
She melted all the snow.
She destroyed the Weather Ball with her eye lasers.
questions.explanation: 天气人跳下车正要再次扔出天气球时，火箭女孩先一步用眼睛的激光把它打成碎片。

questions.question: Why did Terrell look at Roxy suspiciously after the snowstorm?
options: She was carrying a large snowball.
She had forgotten the snowman's name.
He wondered whether Rocket Girl caused the sudden snow.
She said she had been at the art gallery.
questions.explanation: 罗克西回到后院后，特雷尔怀疑这场突如其来的大雪可能与火箭女孩有关，因此用怀疑的眼神看她。

questions.question: What strange event happened at the park lake during the night?
options: A spaceship flew over the trees.
A bright object fell into the lake and turned its water purple.
All the frogs suddenly disappeared.
A large boat sank in the lake.
questions.explanation: 夜晚有发亮的物体从天空落入公园湖中，湖水随即冒泡并变成紫色，为后续青蛙异常埋下线索。

questions.question: What was Jack afraid of while his friends climbed the boulder?
options: High places.
Small frogs.
Cold weather.
Dark classrooms.
questions.explanation: 杰克拒绝爬上大岩石，并说自己不喜欢待在高处，朋友们由此谈起各自害怕的东西。

questions.question: What kind of creatures did Mara say frightened her?
options: All birds in the park.
Fish swimming in deep water.
Robots with bright lights.
Monsters, especially ones with fangs.
questions.explanation: 玛拉告诉朋友们，她害怕怪物，尤其害怕长着尖牙的怪物。

questions.question: What did Roxy want Mara to keep away from her?
options: A large spider.
A bright flashlight.
A small frog.
A toy robot.
questions.explanation: 玛拉捡起一只小青蛙后，罗克西非常反感，叫她把青蛙拿远一些，显露出自己的恐惧。

questions.question: What did Mayor Bloom say about the giant frogs?
options: There was only one frog in the woods.
Giant frogs were appearing all over Metro City.
The frogs had already left the city.
The frogs were part of a school experiment.
questions.explanation: 市长说问题并非只有一只巨型青蛙，而是全城都有巨型青蛙入侵，因此请求火箭女孩帮忙。

questions.question: How did Roxy leave her friends without revealing she was Rocket Girl?
options: She asked Detective Smith to pick her up.
She pretended another giant frog appeared and ran into the woods.
She told them she had to visit the hospital.
She went home with Mara.
questions.explanation: 罗克西为了避开朋友变身，假装看到第二只巨型青蛙，大声提醒大家逃命，然后钻进树林。

questions.question: What did Rocket Girl discover when she reached downtown?
options: People were celebrating a frog festival.
All the frogs had disappeared.
The streets were flooded with ice cream.
Giant frogs were hopping in streets and clinging to buildings.
questions.explanation: 罗克西抵达市中心时发现巨大的黏滑青蛙到处都是，有的沿西街跳跃，还有的趴在楼房外侧。

questions.question: Who was in danger when Rocket Girl looked up at a building?
options: A driver trapped in a car held in a frog's mouth.
A teacher standing on a balcony.
A pilot inside a helicopter.
A child climbing a tree.
questions.explanation: 一只巨型青蛙趴在楼房半腰，嘴里叼着一辆汽车，而司机还在车内，急需救援。

questions.question: How did Rocket Girl protect people from the falling bear statue?
options: She told them to run into a bank.
She asked the mayor to move the statue.
She caught it and put it back on its platform.
She melted it with heat vision.
questions.explanation: 青蛙撞倒熊雕像，雕像正朝人群倾倒，罗克西飞下去接住雕像并将它重新放回基座。

questions.question: What did Rocket Girl do when the frog dropped the car?
options: She froze it in midair.
She caught it before it hit the street.
She pushed it onto a nearby roof.
She asked the police to catch it.
questions.explanation: 巨蛙松开汽车后，罗克西立即俯冲，在汽车撞到地面前及时接住了它，救下车内司机。
